refined_actions.old_action: With known available lesson content and working connection, open Learn home, inspect modules/text/resource entries, and record exact catalog/content identity.
refined_actions.new_action: With independently available lesson content and working connection, inspect named modules/video/text on Learn home and each manual and Knowledge Base resource entry separately. Retain exact content/catalog and offered link identity; external destination, YouTube playlist and no-application-update content delivery remain ungraded source context.

refined_actions.old_action: Visit a nonhome lesson, close and reopen Learn using each documented entry separately without closing Live; use explicit platform/focus.
refined_actions.new_action: Visit an identified nonhome lesson, close Learn with its offered X, then reopen through Help and the exact platform shortcut in separate reset trials while Live stays open. Record Windows Ctrl+Alt+7 or macOS Cmd+Option+7 and ordinary focus. Inspect the returned page. First-open and application-restart histories are separate U observations, never supplied defaults.

refined_actions.old_action: With two distinct available lessons, explicitly choose all lessons, filter a topic, mark one complete and inspect the home indication; compare related links with home filtered versus all.
refined_actions.new_action: Use two independently available lessons. Retain separate all-lessons and topic-filtered home histories, mark one complete and inspect its home indication and related-link presentation. In reset nonhome histories invoke Learn View Home Page and < Lessons separately. Exact strings, catalog/progress persistence and linked destination behavior remain unknown.

refined_actions.old_action: Open a known available lesson video; inspect and operate each offered control in separate reset trials. Independently confirm actual content/output before any future silence or playback assertion.
refined_actions.new_action: With independently available video/content, inspect and operate play/pause, progress scrub, volume, subtitles and picture-in-picture in separate reset trials. Establish genuinely active playback and productive nonzero audio before pause/volume absence observations. Named controls only have documentary roles; actual video/audio/subtitle/seek outcomes remain ungraded.

refined_actions.old_action: On an identified supported OS open lesson picture-in-picture, move/resize, switch to an owned second application and use Learn View arrow. Repeat X separately; record focus/windows without a pixel oracle.
refined_actions.new_action: From a known visible available lesson window, open picture-in-picture and inspect Learn closing, movement and resize roles. Explicitly hover PiP before using X. Separately use Learn View arrow while Live is focused and while over another owned application; retain focus, Learn/PiP visibility and exact OS. Geometry, fullscreen/monitor/privilege and playback consequences remain unknown.

refined_actions.old_action: Establish active positive lesson playback at a known interior landmark, hover controls, invoke each 15 seek separately, then close/reopen views while Live stays open and record source position.
refined_actions.new_action: Establish genuine active lesson playback at an independently known interior landmark. Hover PiP controls and invoke each 15 seek separately. In separate histories close Learn during playback or close PiP during playback, leave Live open and return to the same lesson. Retain actual positions without inferred seek units, rounding, resumption deadline, decoder or timing comparator.
finite_contexts: Learn closed during playback/Live stays open
PiP closed during playback/Live stays open

refined_actions.old_action: On an identified OS explicitly choose each offered appearance/tone mode separately and inspect control states; change OS theme only in a future owned setup, retaining settings and no pixel comparator.
refined_actions.new_action: On an independently supported identified OS choose each offered theme/appearance/tone and high-contrast control separately. Independently vary grid opacity, brightness, color intensity and hue one at a time. Retain offered controls/settings; OS-follow transition, numeric limits, rendered colors/pixels and persistence remain unknown.

refined_actions.old_action: With explicit safe palette and new empty tracks, choose automatic/default/reduced options separately. For new clips compare explicit track-color mode against random mode in separate histories; do not assume every random result differs or infer probability.
refined_actions.new_action: With explicit palette and owned new empty tracks, choose automatic/default/reduced color settings separately. Retain explicit track-color versus random Clip Color histories before creating new clips. Preserve Q031 and matched source/preference/version context; neither every random result differing nor a sequence/distribution/default/unconditional inheritance is assumed.

refined_actions.old_action: With independently supported interface and active nonzero output, inspect offered device/rate/latency/testing controls. In a separate macOS setup select Use System Device and switch between two known working OS outputs; retain positive baselines and no latency/audio oracle.
refined_actions.new_action: With independently supported productive interface/output, inspect offered device/rate/latency/testing controls. On a separately admitted macOS setup inspect Driver Type and Use System Device, then two known productive OS Sound outputs. On Windows separately inspect chosen driver and any offered driver-owned configuration entry. Existing installed supported choices only: no install, universal device support, ASIO-only, failover, audio/latency or transition result is presumed.
finite_contexts: macOS Use System Device/two productive OS outputs

refined_actions.old_action: Change a setting, lesson completion or Info Text and invoke Undo/Redo only where offered; record actual command availability and state.
refined_actions.new_action: From separately known reversible positive settings/lesson/Info Text baselines, inspect actually offered Undo and Redo independently for a setting, lesson completion and note edit. Record command availability, Set/global scope and retained state; no undo grouping, rollback or universal command support is presumed.

refined_actions.old_action: Cancel an offered path/device/settings/content dialog separately and inspect retained settings and partial resources; no rollback policy is assumed.
refined_actions.new_action: At an offered path/device/settings/content dialog before acceptance and while a genuine operation is pending where meaningful, inspect offered Cancel/close separately after a known successful positive baseline. Retain controls/resources/prompts; no cancellation availability, partial-output cleanup or rollback law.
finite_contexts: pending operation: offered Cancel if available
pending operation: offered close if available

refined_actions.old_action: Save/reopen two owned Sets, restart application and separately change user profile in an admitted setup; distinguish Set-specific Info Text from global preferences, content/progress and window state.
refined_actions.new_action: After successful independently available controls/content/notes, use two owned Sets to distinguish Set-specific track/device Info Text from global settings, lesson progress/content and window state. Retain save/reopen, application restart and separately admitted profile histories independently; no persistence/default/account/cache law follows.

refined_actions.old_action: Close lesson/PiP/Settings, Set and application during pending content load or offered settings operation in separate trials; retain prompts, playback and files without leak/cleanup claims.
refined_actions.new_action: At visible idle, genuinely pending content load and pending offered settings-operation checkpoints, close Learn, PiP, Settings, Set and application separately where meaningful. Establish successful productive baselines first; retain prompts/playback/files without cleanup, leak, cancel, persistence or restore guarantees.
